description: Golden question set for the answer-quality evaluation. Every expected fact is taken verbatim or near-verbatim from a file under knowledge-base/India/ — never from outside knowledge. Matching is case-insensitive substring: each entry in expectedFacts is a group of acceptable alternatives, and the group is satisfied if any alternative appears in the answer. forbiddenFacts lists phrases whose presence indicates a fabricated claim no source supports. expectedSources are document titles, matched against citations[].source.
